name: Ballroom
_notes: Ballroom - an open-roof hexagonal gallery on a raised podium in deathball's pit bowl (terrain across the footprint runs 2.7-12.1m, so flat-authored walls buried - the 66x66x4 podium tops at y12.75, above the max sample, and reads as a stage over the bowl, not a floating plate). Six 33.5m walls (3.5m tall, vaultable) grown from the deck with a LEVEL crown at y15.5; invisible ballOnly 'hull' fences continue each wall to ~y45 - open sky, no ceiling; a ball launched over the fences leaves cleanly and the leash snaps it back. ballMix forces variant-0 (smallest, r1.2) even hosted; max12 caps the ambient trickle via spec. balls.zone: spawn inside r18 at deck height, pursuit aims at the room center, leash 30 snaps tunneled balls back inside the 32m corner. Spawn eye y15.5 drops ~1m onto the deck. Solo entry: OFFLINE > BALLS > BALLROOM, or deep link /?mode=classic&map=ballroom. Classic mode forces variant-0 balls so ballMix is host-only.
